answer: Each agent can earn voting weight only by completing a unique, costly task whose result is checked against a public challenge, with rewards released after other agents verify it. A sybil operator must therefore fund and perform the work for every identity, not merely mint accounts; splitting one budget among fake agents does not multiply completed tasks. A canyon route may require a ferrous part, while a raven’s report is independently checked, making fabricated identities an ongoing expense rather than a free source of influence.
